entry.name: leftClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you left click on the widget.

entry.name: rightClickAction
entry.label: What happens when you right click on the widget.

entry.name: scrollEnabled
entry.label: Whether scrolling the mouse on the widget changes the current desktop.

entry.name: scrollInverted
entry.label: Whether scrolling inverts which desktop is selected.

entry.name: scrollHorizontal
entry.label: Whether horizontal scrolling changes the current desktop.

entry.name: navigationWrap
entry.label: Whether the desktop navigation stops at the end or wraps around.

entry.name: singleRow
entry.label: Whether the widget displays in a single row, or follows Plasma's configuration.

entry.name: indicatorType
entry.label: Which style of desktop indicator will be used.

entry.name: indicatorSpacing
entry.label: The amount of spacing between indicators.

entry.name: textRotation
entry.label: How indicator text will be rotated on vertical panels.

entry.name: minimalStyle
entry.label: What style of minimal indicator to display.

entry.name: minimalCharActive
entry.label: The unicode character used for the active desktop indicator.

entry.name: minimalCharInactive
entry.label: The unicode character used for the inactive desktop indicator.

entry.name: minimalSizeMode
entry.label: How the size of indicator characters is rendered.

entry.name: minimalSizeCustom
entry.label: Indicator size in pixels when minimalSizeMode is "custom".

entry.name: labelWidth
entry.label: Width in pixels of each label

entry.name: labelType
entry.label: Whether labels shows the desktop number or desktop name.

entry.name: labelTypeTemplate
entry.label: Label template: %n is replaced by the desktop number, %d by the desktop name.

entry.name: labelTypeList
entry.label: Label text for each virtual desktop, by position, when labelType is "list".

entry.name: highlightType
entry.label: Highlight style for the active desktop: line, circle, or none.

entry.name: labelSizeType
entry.label: How label textsize is rendered: theme, scale with panel, or custom size.

entry.name: labelActiveSize
entry.label: Active label text size in pixels when labelSizeType is "custom".

entry.name: labelSize
entry.label: Inactive label text size in pixels when labelSizeType is "custom".

entry.name: labelWrap
entry.label: Whether to wrap label text if there is space for multiple lines

entry.name: labelActiveBold
entry.label: Whether the current desktop label text is bold.

entry.name: labelBold
entry.label: Whether inactive desktop label text is bold.

entry.name: labelActiveItalic
entry.label: Whether current desktop label text is italic.

entry.name: labelItalic
entry.label: Whether inactive desktop label text is italic.

entry.name: iconNames
entry.label: List of icon names or paths for each virtual desktop

entry.name: iconColorMode
entry.label: Choose how icons are coloured.

entry.name: indicatorCustomColors
entry.label: Allow indicator text/label colours to be customised.

entry.name: indicatorColorActive
entry.label: Colour of the current desktop's indicator when indicatorCustomColors is true.

entry.name: indicatorColorInactive
entry.label: Colour of inactive desktop indicators when indicatorCustomColors is true.

entry.name: highlightCustomColors
entry.label: Allow highlight colours to be customised.

entry.name: highlightColor
entry.label: Colour of highlight colours when highlightCustomColors is true.
